sources.title: Qwen3.5 — Alibaba Open-Weight 397B Model Specs | AI/TLDR
sources.snippet: The flagship was followed by smaller open-weight variants — Qwen3.5-122B-A10B, 35B-A3B, and 27B on 24 February 2026, then 9B, 4B, 2B, and 0.8B on 2 March 2026 — covering everything from data-center MoE to edge-sized dense models. A hosted, proprietary Qwen3.5-Plus endpoint extends the context window to 1M tokens.

sources.title: Qwen3.5: 9B Beats 120B, 0.8B Runs Video on Phones—Full MoE Family
sources.snippet: On March 2, the Qwen3.5 Small Model Series went open-source — Qwen3.5-0.8B, 2B, 4B, and 9B, all under Apache 2.0. The 9B model scores 81.7 on GPQA Diamond, beating OpenAI's GPT-OSS-120B (71.5) — a model 13.5x its size — while the 0.8B can process video on a smartphone. This is the Qwen3.5 architecture advantage playing out at every scale.
